chapters.reason: The paper introduces a training framework (CODI) that uses self-distillation to compress explicit CoT into continuous space, which is a specialized training strategy for CoT-aligned supervision.
CODI enables implicit CoT reasoning within standard transformer architectures without changing the underlying structure, focusing on latent reasoning capabilities.
The paper demonstrates the capability of the model to perform multi-step reasoning in a latent continuous space, matching explicit CoT performance on complex datasets like GSM8k.
